identity.title: Build Overview and Problems console views

human_pressure.one_screen_brief: Complete the MVP console with fleet Overview and Problems views sourced entirely from aggregate APIs. Overview shows execution health, validation, scope, fallback, and governance signal counts. Problems supports aggregate -> affected runs -> evidence-linked signal drill-down. Dependency: 8024.build-runs-console.
human_pressure.why_now: This closes the visibility -> problem discovery loop that motivates EverRun dogfooding.
do_not_misread: This pack is intentionally narrow; do not absorb later packs into it.
Evidence is authoritative; derived state must remain reconstructable from evidence.
red_lines: No client-side aggregation over raw evidence.
Do not introduce a new BLOCKED or HUMAN_REVIEW path for non-capability reasons.

machine_core.goal: Add deterministic aggregate Overview and Problems screens without governance score or AI diagnosis.
red_lines: No client-side aggregation over raw evidence.
Do not introduce a new BLOCKED or HUMAN_REVIEW path for non-capability reasons.
invariants: Depends on: 8024.build-runs-console. Do not implement this pack against an incompatible predecessor state.
Overview/Problems are product views over server aggregates.
contracts: Aggregate -> run -> evidence navigation is preserved.
failure_semantics: Empty/no-signal window is shown as no observed signals, not proven healthy.

steps.title: Render Problems list
details: Signal type, count, first/last seen, severity distribution/trend.

steps.title: Render Problem detail
details: Affected run links and contributing signal evidence refs.

steps.title: Test product red lines
details: No model-quality wording for fallback metrics.
No AI diagnosis placeholder presented as fact.

acceptance: Problems loads from problem endpoint and drills to runs.
No composite governance score is shown.
Fallback metrics are labeled observed runtime behavior/reliability, not model quality.

reject_if: Problem list groups raw log text client-side.
Unknown or missing evidence is treated as passed.
Do not introduce a new BLOCKED or HUMAN_REVIEW path for non-capability reasons.

validation_notes.targeted_contract_coverage: Focused console aggregate view contract tests.
